content_text: Thanks, Roger! I’ve actually never heard of hard gel, I suppose if you’re looking for a more long term solution that sounds like a way to go, if you have a bit of budget going spare! I’ve recently been on a commercial where we had a lot of big windows in very bright countries and I was often butting up against the natural 4′ width of gel rolls, with net’s textured look sometimes being too visible. It’s one of those things that’s always a bit of a headache. Thanks again for your replies.
